cs.t: I have used Soundcore q20i for more than a year, and I'm sure the AirPods have a better sound and have a better noise cancelling, but the difference in price $549 and 30€ (as I bought them) is pretty insane, also my Soundcore q20i last much longer than 20h and the noise cancelling is already quite good. Edit: also has a proper cushion on the headband.

You may have heard of Anker, a company of power banks, cables and remarkably cheap yet good speakers, but did you know it also owns SoundCore, a budget-friendly earbuds and headphone maker? I tested their Q20i earbuds, and was pleasantly surprised - in more mays than one...
